description: In every PA-model, if positive \(d\) is divisible by every positive \(j\le n+1\), the moduli \(1+(i+1)d\), for \(i\le n\), are pairwise coprime.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.betaModulus_pairwise_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (d n : M)
  (hD :
    ∀ (t : M),
      t ≠ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M →
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M t
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M n) →
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.DividesModel M t d)
  (i j : M) (hi : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M i n)
  (hj : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M j n) (hne : i ≠ j) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.CoprimeModel M
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.betaModulusValue M d i)
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.betaModulusValue M d j)
